notes: One set of power specs covers the 3- and 4-wheel Scout. The 12 V x 20 Ah pair is for the EXT model only.

gaps: The SC31xxx part numbers are not checked against a Drive Medical parts list.
Battery sizes conflict: the manual lists 12AH or 20AH batteries, while Westin's sheet gives the 12 V x 20 Ah pair for the EXT model only.
Westin's parts list names a wiring harness 'Scout, Curtis Electronics' (SC31026), while every spec table gives the controller as CTE 45A.
It is unclear whether some production runs used a Curtis controller.
method: The scooter is a compact 3-wheel travel scooter.
Read as text from the PDFs.
Battery and motor ratings come from Drive Medical's own order form (media.drivemedical.com), which also gives the controller as CTE 45A and a 2A charger.
Part numbers come from a product sheet published by Westin Healthcare, a Canadian seller (westinhealthcare.ca), whose parts list uses SC31xxx part numbers.
The Westin sheet repeats the same specs (CTE 45A, 24V x 270W x 4700 rpm, 2A offboard charger).
The owner's manual used is the copy on Westin's site, REV5.9.1.15; a later copy, REV6.3.20.17, on a retailer's Shopify CDN, gives the same spec table and parts diagram list.
The manual says to use only sealed lead-acid AGM or gel-cell batteries and lists 12AH or 20AH batteries.
The manual describes regenerative braking plus a park brake that locks the drive wheels automatically once the scooter stops.

comps.spec: Pair of 12 V 12 Ah batteries, included as standard
Drive motor 24 V x 270 W x 4700 rpm
Controller listed as CTE 45A; replacement part SC31052 'Controller, 45A, Scout 3-Wheel'
Transaxle with motor and brake, Scout, part SC31053
Wire harness 'Scout, Curtis Electronics', part SC31026; also front/rear connector block set with harness, part SC31033
Circuit breaker, item 12 in the manual's scooter parts diagram
